title: Decision stability across saved scenarios
sql:
SELECT d.verdict, d.kstar AS cap, COUNT(*) AS scenarios,
       ROUND(AVG(s.p_pair)*100, 2) AS avg_pair_conflict_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(s.q_catch)*100, 0) AS avg_check_catch_pct
FROM decisions d JOIN scenarios s ON s.id = d.scenario_id
GROUP BY d.verdict, d.kstar ORDER BY scenarios DESC;

title: Where point estimates and the CI rule disagree
sql:
SELECT s.name, d.kstar_point AS point_rule_k, d.kstar AS ci_rule_k,
       ROUND(r.conflict*100, 2) AS conflict_pct_at_point_k,
       ROUND(r.conflict_hi*100, 2) AS conflict_upper_pct
FROM decisions d
JOIN scenarios s ON s.id = d.scenario_id
JOIN results r ON r.scenario_id = d.scenario_id AND r.k = d.kstar_point
WHERE d.kstar_point <> d.kstar ORDER BY s.id DESC;

title: Savings at the chosen cap vs. check quality
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.q_catch >= 0.8 THEN 'check >= 80%'
            WHEN s.q_catch >= 0.5 THEN 'check 50-79%' ELSE 'check < 50%' END AS check_quality,
       COUNT(*) AS scenarios, ROUND(AVG(d.kstar), 2) AS avg_cap,
       ROUND(AVG(r.savings)*100, 1) AS avg_savings_pct
FROM decisions d JOIN scenarios s ON s.id = d.scenario_id
LEFT JOIN results r ON r.scenario_id = d.scenario_id AND r.k = d.kstar
GROUP BY check_quality ORDER BY avg_cap DESC;
